profiles.name: Refractor Field
chars: This model has a 5+ invulnerable save.

profiles.name: The Cult of Sacrifice
chars: This unit ignores models slain in the Shooting phase when taking Morale tests.

profiles.name: Death Korps Voice of Command
chars: This unit may issue order to those under their command at the start of any of their Shooting phases. Orders may only be issued to INFANTRY or CAVALRY units within 6" of this unit that have the DEATH KORPS OF KRIEG keyword. To issue an order, pick a target unit and choose which order you wish to issue from the table below. A unit may only be affected by one order per turn.

profiles.name: Plasma pistol, Supercharge
chars: On a hit roll of 1, the bearer is slain.

profiles.name: Chainsword
chars: Each time the bearer fights, it can make 1 additional attack with this weapon.

profiles.name: Power fist
chars: When attacking with this weapon, you must subtract 1 from the hit roll.

profiles.name: Duty unto death!
chars: Any INFANTRY or CALVARY model in the units that is killed in the Fight phase immediately makes a single attack.

profiles.name: Without Mercy
chars: All lasguns and hot-shot lasguns in the ordered unit change their Type to Pistol 2 until the end of the turn.

profiles.name: Forwards for the Emperor!
chars: The ordered unit can shoot this phase even if it Advanced in its Movement phase.

profiles.name: Get Back in the Fight!
chars: The ordered unit can shoot this phase even if it Fell Back in its Movement phase.

profiles.name: Move! Move! Move!
chars: Instead of shooting this phase, the ordered unit immediately moves as if it were the Movement phase. It must Advance as part of this move, and cannot declare a charge during this turn.

profiles.name: Fix Bayonets!
chars: This order can only be issued to units that are within 1" of an enemy unit. The ordered unit immediately fights as if it were the Fight phase.

profiles.name: Bring it Down!
chars: Re-roll wound rolls of 1 for all the models in the ordered unit until the end of the phase.

profiles.name: Grand Strategist
chars: Whilst your Warlord is alive, you can re-roll a single hit roll, wound roll or saving throw per battle. In addition, if your army is Battle-forged and this Warlord is on the battlefield, roll a dice for each Command Point spent when using Stratagems. On a 5+ that Command Point is immediately refunded

profiles.name: Old Grudges
chars: After deployment, but before the first battle round begins, choose a unit in your opponent’s army. You can re-roll failed wound rolls for ASTRA MILITARUM units from your army that target the unit you chose whilst they are within 6" of your Warlord.

profiles.name: Implacable Determination
chars: When your Warlord and a single friendly unit within 3" of them Advances, they may both add 6" to their Move characteristic for that Movement phase instead of rolling a dice

profiles.name: Draconian Disiplinarian
chars: You can re-roll failed Morale tests for friendly ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY units within 6" of your Warlord in the Morale phase.

profiles.name: Bellowing Voice
chars: Add 3" to the range of any abilities on your Warlord’s datasheet (such as Aura of Discipline or Voice of Command).

profiles.name: Master of Command
chars: Your Warlord gains the Voice of Command ability. If your Warlord already has the Voice of Command or Tank Orders ability, they may instead issue one additional order per turn.

profiles.name: Lord of Ordnance
chars: Each time you roll a wound roll of 6+ for an attack made by a friendly EMPEROR’S WRATH unit while they are within 6" of your Warlord in the Shooting phase, the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack is improved by 1 (i.e. AP0 becomes AP-1, AP-1 becomes AP-2).

profiles.name: Unflinching Resolve
chars: You can re-roll hit rolls when your Warlord, and friendly EMPEROR’S FIST units within 6" of your Warlord, fire Overwatch.

profiles.name: Legendary Fighter
chars: If this warlord charges in the charge phase, add 1 to their attacks characteristic until the end of the ensuing fight phase.

profiles.name: Inspiring Leader
chars: Friendly units within 6" of this warlord can add 1 to their leadership characteristic.

profiles.name: Tenacious Survivor
chars: Roll a dice each time this warlord loses a wound. On a 6, the warlord shrugs off the damage and does not lose the wound.

profiles.name: The Laurels of Command
chars: OFFICER with Voice of Command ability only. Roll a dice each time the bearer issues an order to a friendly <REGIMENT>unit within 6" of them. On a 4+ the bearer can immediately issue another order to the same unit. This does not count towards the maximum number of orders this model may issue each turn.

profiles.name: The Emperor's Benediction
chars: COMMISSAR or LORD COMMISSAR with a bolt pistol only. The Emperor’s Benediction replaces the model’s bolt pistol and has the following profile:

profiles.name: The Emperor's Benediction
chars: This weapon can target a Character even if it is not the closest enemy unit, unless the bearer is within 1" of an enemy unit.

profiles.name: The Deathmask of Ollanius
chars: INFANTRY model only. The bearer of this item has a 4+ invulnerable save. In addition, once per game, at the start of any of your turns, the bearer may immediately heal D3 wounds.

profiles.name: The Dagger of Tu'Sakh
chars: INFANTRY OFFICER model only. During deployment, you can set up the bearer and one INFANTRY unit from your army behind enemy lines instead of placing them on the battlefield. The infantry unit must have the same <REGIMENT> keyword as the bearer if the bearer has one.At the end of any of your Movement phases these units can launch their daring attack – set them up within 3" of each other, anywhere on the battlefield that is wholly within 6" of any battlefield edge and more than 9" away from any enemy models.

profiles.name: Kurov's Aquila
chars: OFFICERS only. Each time your opponent uses a Stratagem, roll a D6. On a 5+ you gain 1 Command Point.

profiles.name: The Blade of Conquest
chars: Model with power sword only. The Blade of Conquest replaces the model’s power sword and has the following profile:

profiles.name: Hammer of Sunderance
chars: Model with battle cannon only. Hammer of Sunderance replaces the bearer’s battle cannon and has the following profile:

profiles.name: Agripinaa-Class Orbital Tracker
chars: In your Shooting phase, pick an EMPEROR’S WRATH unit from your army within 6" of the bearer. Until the end of that phase, enemy units do not receive the benefit of cover when targeted by shooting attacks made by that unit.

profiles.name: 11: Inspirational Fighter
chars: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 in the Fight phase for friendly <Sub-faction> units within 6" of this model.

profiles.name: 12: Beast Hunter
chars: You can re-roll failed wound rolls for attacks made by this model in the Fight phase if the target is a MONSTER unit.

profiles.name: 13: Heroic
chars: This model can perform a Heroic Intervention if, after the enemy has completed all of their charge moves, it is within 6" of any enemy units, and can move up to 6" when doing so.

profiles.name: 14: Duelist
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Strength and Attacks characteristics while it is within 1" of any enemy Character units.

profiles.name: 15: Zealot
chars: You can re-roll failed hit rolls for this model in the Fight phase if it made a charge move, performed a Heroic Intervention, or was charged this turn.

profiles.name: 16: Deadly Charge
chars: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this model in the Fight phase if it made a charge move this turn.

profiles.name: 21: Targeting Augury
chars: Enemy units do not gain the benefit of cover to their saving throws against attacks made by friendly <Sub-faction> units within 6" of this model when the attack is made.

profiles.name: 22: Directed Fire
chars: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 in the Shooting phase for friendly <Sub-faction> units within 6" of this model.

profiles.name: 23: Deadly Marksman
chars: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of ranged weapons used by this model.

profiles.name: 24: Sundering Shots
chars: Each wound roll of 6+ made for this model’s ranged attacks inflicts 1 mortal wound on the target in addition to any normal damage.

profiles.name: 25: Keen Eye
chars: This model can target enemy CHARACTER units in the Shooting phase even if they are not the closest enemy model.

profiles.name: 26: Defensive Fighter
chars: When this model fires Overwatch, it successfully hits on rolls of 5 or 6, instead of only 6.

profiles.name: 31: Grudge
chars: You can re-roll any hit, wound and damage rolls made for this model’s attacks that target the enemy Warlord.

profiles.name: 32: Resilient
chars: Each time this model loses a wound, roll a dice; on a 5+ it does not lose that wound.

profiles.name: 33: Camoflage
chars: Add 2 instead of 1 to saving throws made for this model when it is receiving the benefit of cover.

profiles.name: 34: Stealth Assault
chars: Enemy units cannot fire Overwatch at this model.

profiles.name: 35: Indomitable
chars: All damage suffered by this model is halved (rounding up).

profiles.name: 36: Impervious
chars: This model regains 1 lost wound at the start of your turn.

profiles.name: 41: Infiltrator
chars: During deployment, you can set up this model in ambush, instead of placing it on the battlefield. At the end of any of your Movement phases it can reveal its location – set it up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" from any enemy models.

profiles.name: 42: Stealthy
chars: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made with ranged weapons that target this model.

profiles.name: 43: Hard to Kill
chars: Wound rolls of 1, 2 or 3 made for attacks that target this model always fail, even if the attack has a Strength characteristic higher than this model’s Toughness characteristic.

profiles.name: 44: Strategic Feint
chars: At the start of the first battle round but before the first turn begins, you can pick a friendly <Sub-faction> unit within 6" of this model and set it up again, anywhere wholly within your deployment zone. If your opponent has any units with similar abilities, roll off; starting with the winner of the roll-off, take it in turns to resolve these abilities.

profiles.name: 45: Swift Strike
chars: You can always choose this model to fight first in the Fight phase even if it did not charge. If the enemy has units that have charged, or that have a similar ability, alternate choosing units to fight with, starting with the player whose turn is taking place.

profiles.name: 46: Foresight
chars: Once per battle, if this model is on the battlefield, you can re-roll one hit roll, wound roll, damage roll or saving throw.

profiles.name: 51: Inspirational Leader
chars: Friendly <Sub-faction>units can use this model’s Leadership instead of their own while they are within 6" of it.

profiles.name: 52: Rallying Cry
chars: You can re-roll failed Morale tests for friendly <Sub-faction>units while they are within 6" of this model.

profiles.name: 53: Icon of Retribution
chars: Roll a dice each time a friendly <Sub-faction>model within 6" of this model is slain in the Fight phase. On a 6, the unit that made the attack that slew the model suffers 1 mortal wound after it has finished making its attacks.

profiles.name: 54: Impetuous
chars: You can re-roll failed charge rolls for this model.

profiles.name: 55: Terrifying
chars: Subtract 1 from the Leadership characteristic of enemy units while they are within 3" of this model.

profiles.name: 56: Savage Riposte
chars: Each time you roll an unmodified saving throw of 6 for this model in the Fight phase, the enemy unit that made the attack suffers 1 mortal wound after it has resolved all of its attacks.

profiles.name: 61: Air Strike
chars: Once per battle, in your Shooting phase, you can pick an enemy unit, other than a Characterunit, that is visible to this model and roll a D6. On a 1-4 nothing happens. On a 5+ the target unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

profiles.name: 62: Swift Advance
chars: When this model Advances, add 6" to its Move characteristic for that Movement phase instead of rolling a D6

profiles.name: 63: Reactive Tactics
chars: This model, and friendly<Sub-faction>units within 6" of them, can charge even if they Fell Back that turn.

profiles.name: 64: Strike and Fade
chars: After this model has fought in the Fight phase, it can immediately pile in D3+3" in any direction, not just towards the closest enemy model.

profiles.name: 65: Final Strike
chars: If this model is slain, you can select an enemy unit within 3" of it and roll a D6; on a 2+ that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

profiles.name: 66: Direct Fire
chars: Each time you make a wound roll of 6+ in the Shooting phase for a friendly <Sub-faction>unit within 6" of this model, the AP characteristic of that attack is improved by 1 (e.g. AP -1 becomes AP -2).

profiles.name: 02: Auto-loader
chars: Pick one of this model’s ranged weapons. Increase the number of shots this weapon makes by 1 (e.g. a Pistol 1 weapon becomes a Pistol 2 weapon).

profiles.name: 03: Penetrator Rounds
chars: Pick one of this model’s ranged weapons. Improve that weapon’s AP characteristic by 1 (e.g. AP -1 becomes AP -2).

profiles.name: 04: High Calibre
chars: Pick one of this model’s ranged weapons. Add 1 to that weapon’s Strength characteristic.

profiles.name: 05: Improved Sights
chars: Pick one of this model’s ranged weapons. Add 6" to that weapon’s Range characteristic.

profiles.name: 06: Inferno Round
chars: Pick one of this model’s ranged weapons. Add the following ability to that weapon: ‘Units do not receive the benefit of cover to their saving throws against attacks made with this weapon.’

profiles.name: 07: Artificer Weapon
chars: Pick one of this model’s weapons. Add 1 to that weapon’s Damage characteristic.

profiles.name: 08: Finely Balanced
chars: Pick one of this model’s melee weapons. Add the following ability to that weapon: ‘Each time the bearer fights, it can make 1 additional attack with this weapon.’

profiles.name: 09: Shredder
chars: Pick one of this model’s melee weapons. Add the following ability to that weapon: ‘You can re-roll failed wound rolls for attacks made with this weapon.’

profiles.name: 10: Brutal
chars: Pick one of this model’s melee weapons. Improve that weapon’s Strength characteristic by 1 (e.g. User becomes +1, +1 becomes +2).

profiles.name: 11: Razor-edged
chars: Pick one of this model’s melee weapons. Improve that weapon’s AP characteristic by 1 (e.g. AP -1 becomes AP -2).

profiles.name: 12: Heirloom
chars: Pick one of this model’s melee weapons. Add the following ability to that weapon: ‘Each unmodified hit roll of 6 made for attacks with this weapon scores 2 hits instead of 1’.

profiles.name: 1: Psychic Might
chars: Add 1 to the number of psychic powers this character can attempt to manifest in your Psychic phase.

profiles.name: 2: Adamantium Will
chars: Add 1 to the number of psychic powers this character can attempt to deny in your opponent’s Psychic phase.

profiles.name: 3: Master of Lore
chars: Add 1 to the number of psychic powers this model knows from one of the psychic disciplines available to them.

profiles.name: 02: Old War Wound
chars: Select a result from this table, or roll 2D6 to randomly select a result (re-roll if you get this result again). Subtract or worsen this model’s characteristic by the amount described in the result you picked instead of adding or improving it (e.g. if the Ferocious Combatant result was selected, an Attacks characteristic of 3 would become 2, while if the Dead-eyed result was selected, a BS of 3+ would become 4+)

profiles.name: 03: Courageous
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Leadership characteristic.

profiles.name: 04: Ferocious Combatant
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Attacks characteristic.

profiles.name: 05: Mighty
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Strength characteristic.

profiles.name: 06: Dead-eyed
chars: Improve this model’s Ballistic Skill characteristic by 1 (e.g. BS 3+ will become BS 2+), to a maximum of 2+.

profiles.name: 07: Fleet
chars: Add 2" to this model’s Move characteristic.

profiles.name: 08: Blademaster
chars: Improve this model’s Weapon Skill characteristic by 1 (e.g. WS 3+ will become WS 2+), to a maximum of 2+.

profiles.name: 09: Enhanced Physiology
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Toughness characteristic.

profiles.name: 10: Toughened Armor
chars: Improve this model’s Save characteristic by 1 (e.g. Sv 5+ will become Sv 4+), to a maximum of 2+.

profiles.name: 11: Divine Protection
chars: Improve this model’s invulnerable save by 1 (e.g. an invulnerable save of 5+ will become an invulnerable save of 4+), to a maximum of 3+. If this model does not have an invulnerable save, it instead gains a 6+ invulnerable save.

profiles.name: 12: Heroic Constitution
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Wounds characteristic.

chars: This unit ignores models slain in the Shooting phase when taking Morale tests.

Subtract or worsen this model’s characteristic by the amount described in the result you picked instead of adding or improving it (e.g. if the Ferocious Combatant result was selected, an Attacks characteristic of 3 would become 2, while if the Dead-eyed result was selected, a BS of 3+ would become 4+)

profiles.name: 03: Courageous
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Leadership characteristic.

profiles.name: 04: Ferocious Combatant
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Attacks characteristic.

profiles.name: 05: Mighty
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Strength characteristic.

profiles.name: 06: Dead-eyed
chars: Improve this model’s Ballistic Skill characteristic by 1 (e.g. BS 3+ will become BS 2+), to a maximum of 2+.

profiles.name: 07: Fleet
chars: Add 2" to this model’s Move characteristic.

profiles.name: 08: Blademaster
chars: Improve this model’s Weapon Skill characteristic by 1 (e.g. WS 3+ will become WS 2+), to a maximum of 2+.

profiles.name: 09: Enhanced Physiology
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Toughness characteristic.

profiles.name: 10: Toughened Armor
chars: Improve this model’s Save characteristic by 1 (e.g. Sv 5+ will become Sv 4+), to a maximum of 2+.

profiles.name: 11: Divine Protection
chars: Improve this model’s invulnerable save by 1 (e.g. an invulnerable save of 5+ will become an invulnerable save of 4+), to a maximum of 3+. If this model does not have an invulnerable save, it instead gains a 6+ invulnerable save.

profiles.name: 12: Heroic Constitution
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Wounds characteristic.

profiles.name: Transport: Centaur Light Carrier
chars: This model can transport 5 ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY models.  Each Heavy Weapons Team or Veteran Heavy Weapons Team takes the place of two other models and each OGRYN takes the space of three other models.

profiles.name: Artillery Tractor
chars: If this model starts its move within 1" of a friendly ASTRA MILITARUM ARTILLERY model, it can choose to tow it so long as neither this model nor the ARTILLERY model is within 1" of an enemy model. If it does this, this model immediately makes a move of up to 12" The ARTILLERY model is then placed anywhere withing 1" of this model so that no part of the ARTILLERY model has moved more than 12" from where it started. An ARTILLERY model that has been towed may not fire its weapons during the Shooting phase of the same turn.

profiles.name: Smoke Launchers
chars: Once per game, instead of shooting any weapons in the Shooting phase, this model can use its Smoke Launchers; until your next Shooting phase your opponent must subtract 1 from all hit rolls for ranged weapons that target this vehicle.

profiles.name: Explodes (6+/6"/D3)
chars: If this model is reduced to 0 wounds, roll a D6 before removing it from the battlefield and before any embarked models disembark. On a 6 it explodes, and each unit within 6" suffers D3 mortal wounds.

profiles.name: Hunter-killer missile
chars: A model can only fire each of its hunter killer missiles once per battle.

profiles.name: R1: Sharpshooters
chars: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for this unit in the Shooting phase.

profiles.name: R1: Agile
chars: You can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls for this unit.

profiles.name: R1: Deadeye Shots
chars: Each time you roll an unmodified wound roll of 6 for an attack with one of this unit’s ranged weapons, increase the Damage characteristic of that attack by 1.

profiles.name: R1: Grizzled
chars: This unit ignores penalties to their Leadership characteristic.

profiles.name: R2: Combat Specialists
chars: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for this unit in the Fight phase.

profiles.name: R2: Assassins
chars: Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by models in this unit that target an enemy CHARACTER unit.

profiles.name: R3: Trophy Takers
chars: Subtract 1 from the Leadership characteristic of enemy units while they are within 6" of this unit.

profiles.name: R4: Disciplined
chars: This unit can shoot or charge during a turn in which it Fell Back.

profiles.name: R5: Brutal
chars: Add 1 to the Strength and Attacks characteristic of models in this unit during any turn in which they made a successful charge move.

profiles.name: R2: Lucky
chars: Roll a D6 each time a model from this unit loses a wound; on a 6 the model does not lose that wound.

profiles.name: R3: Breachers
chars: Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by models in this unit if the target of those attacks is receiving the benefit of cover.

profiles.name: R1: Unstoppable Beast
chars: After this model completes a charge move, roll a D6 for each enemy unit within 1" of it. On a 4+ that unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

profiles.name: R1: Monstrous Regeneration
chars: This model regains 1 lost wound at the start of each of your turns.

profiles.name: R2: Terrifying
chars: Subtract 1 from the Leadership characteristic of enemy units while they are within 6" of this model.

profiles.name: R2: Lashing Limbs
chars: Each time you roll an unmodified saving throw of 6 for this model in the Fight phase, the enemy unit that made that attack suffers 1 mortal wound after it has resolved all of its attacks.

profiles.name: R3: Inhuman Resilience
chars: Roll a D6 each time a model in this unit loses a wound; on a 5+ the model does not lose that wound

profiles.name: R3: Sweeping Blows
chars: Each unmodified hit roll of 6 made for this model’s attacks in the Fight phase score 2 hits instead of 1.

profiles.name: R4: Juggernaut
chars: You can re-roll charge rolls for this model.

profiles.name: R5: Just Making it Angry
chars: If this model has a damage table, double the number of wounds it has remaining for the purposes of determining what its Strength and Attacks characteristics are.

profiles.name: R5: Eager
chars: At the start of the first battle round but before the first turn begins, you can move this model up to 5". It cannot end this move within 9" of any enemy models. If both players have units that can do this, the player who is taking the first turn moves their units first.

profiles.name: R1: Famed Commander
chars: Roll a D6 each time a model in this unit loses a wound; on a 6 the model does not lose that wound.

profiles.name: R1: Skilled Driver
chars: You can re-roll Advance rolls for this unit.

profiles.name: R2: Experimental Ammunition
chars: Select one of the ranged weapons used by one or more models in this unit. Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of that weapon for attacks made by that unit.

profiles.name: R2: Advanced Targeting
chars: Add 6" to the maximum range of this unit’s Heavy and Rapid Fire weapons that have an unmodified maximum range of 24" or longer.

profiles.name: R3: Ablative Armor
chars: Attacks against this unit that have an AP characteristic of -1 are treated as having an AP characteristic of 0 instead.

profiles.name: R3: Storied Vehicle
chars: You can re-roll one hit roll or wound roll for this unit in each of your Shooting phases.

profiles.name: R4: Blessed Drive
chars: If this model has a damage table, double the number of wounds it has remaining for the purposes of determining what its Move characteristic is.

profiles.name: R4: Last Resort
chars: If a model in this unit is destroyed, the controlling player can choose for it to automatically explode – no dice roll is required.

profiles.name: R5: Prominent Trophy
chars: Add 1 to the Leadership characteristic of friendly units while they are within 6" of this unit. Subtract 1 from the Leadership characteristic of enemy units while they are within 6" of this unit.

profiles.name: R5: Blessed Weapons
chars: If this model has a damage table, double the number of wounds it has remaining for the purposes of determining what its Ballistic Skill characteristic is.

profiles.name: Etherium
chars: Each time an enemy model attacks this model, the attacks are resolved as if the the attacker had a BS/WS of 6+

profiles.name: Life Drain
chars: Armour saves cannot be taken against close combat attacks made by this model

profiles.name: Abomination
chars: This model can never be targeted or affected by psychic powers in any way. PSYKERS that are within 18" of any Culexus Assassins must subtract 2 from Psychic tests and Deny the witch tests they take.

profiles.name: Psychic Assassin
chars: This model can target a CHARACTER that is a PSYKER, even if it is not the closest enemy unit. In addition, this model can make an attack with a psyk-out grenade in the same phase it uses it's animus speculum.

rules.name: Independent Operative
rules.text: This Model can never have a Warlord Trait. During deployment, you can set this model up in concealment instead of placing it on the battlefield. At the end of any of your movement phases, this model can reveal it's position - set it up anywhere on the battlefield that is more then 9" from any enemy model.

rules.name: Lightning Reflexes
rules.text: A model with this special rule has a 4+ invulnerable save.

rules.name: Execution Force
rules.text: So long as your Warlord is from the IMPERIUM, you can include this unit in a Vanguard Detachment even if that Detachment contains no HQ units. However, if you do so, that Detachment's Command Benefits are changed to 'None' unless that Detachment contains exactly 1 of each assassin.

profiles.name: Animus Speculum
chars: Change this weapon's type to Assault D6 if there are enemy PSYKERS within 18" of the bearer

profiles.name: Psyk-out Grenades
chars: Each time you roll a hit roll of 6+ for this weapon when targeting a PSYKER or DAEMON, the target suffers a mortal wound instead of the normal damage.

profiles.name: 11: Inspirational Fighter
chars: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 in the Fight phase for friendly <Sub-faction> units within 6" of this model.

profiles.name: 12: Beast Hunter
chars: You can re-roll failed wound rolls for attacks made by this model in the Fight phase if the target is a MONSTER unit.

profiles.name: 13: Heroic
chars: This model can perform a Heroic Intervention if, after the enemy has completed all of their charge moves, it is within 6" of any enemy units, and can move up to 6" when doing so.

profiles.name: 14: Duelist
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Strength and Attacks characteristics while it is within 1" of any enemy Character units.

profiles.name: 15: Zealot
chars: You can re-roll failed hit rolls for this model in the Fight phase if it made a charge move, performed a Heroic Intervention, or was charged this turn.

profiles.name: 16: Deadly Charge
chars: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this model in the Fight phase if it made a charge move this turn.

profiles.name: 21: Targeting Augury
chars: Enemy units do not gain the benefit of cover to their saving throws against attacks made by friendly <Sub-faction> units within 6" of this model when the attack is made.

profiles.name: 22: Directed Fire
chars: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 in the Shooting phase for friendly <Sub-faction> units within 6" of this model.

profiles.name: 23: Deadly Marksman
chars: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of ranged weapons used by this model.

profiles.name: 24: Sundering Shots
chars: Each wound roll of 6+ made for this model’s ranged attacks inflicts 1 mortal wound on the target in addition to any normal damage.

profiles.name: 25: Keen Eye
chars: This model can target enemy CHARACTER units in the Shooting phase even if they are not the closest enemy model.

profiles.name: 26: Defensive Fighter
chars: When this model fires Overwatch, it successfully hits on rolls of 5 or 6, instead of only 6.

profiles.name: 31: Grudge
chars: You can re-roll any hit, wound and damage rolls made for this model’s attacks that target the enemy Warlord.

profiles.name: 32: Resilient
chars: Each time this model loses a wound, roll a dice; on a 5+ it does not lose that wound.

profiles.name: 33: Camoflage
chars: Add 2 instead of 1 to saving throws made for this model when it is receiving the benefit of cover.

profiles.name: 34: Stealth Assault
chars: Enemy units cannot fire Overwatch at this model.

profiles.name: 35: Indomitable
chars: All damage suffered by this model is halved (rounding up).

profiles.name: 36: Impervious
chars: This model regains 1 lost wound at the start of your turn.

profiles.name: 41: Infiltrator
chars: During deployment, you can set up this model in ambush, instead of placing it on the battlefield. At the end of any of your Movement phases it can reveal its location – set it up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" from any enemy models.

profiles.name: 42: Stealthy
chars: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made with ranged weapons that target this model.

profiles.name: 43: Hard to Kill
chars: Wound rolls of 1, 2 or 3 made for attacks that target this model always fail, even if the attack has a Strength characteristic higher than this model’s Toughness characteristic.

profiles.name: 44: Strategic Feint
chars: At the start of the first battle round but before the first turn begins, you can pick a friendly <Sub-faction> unit within 6" of this model and set it up again, anywhere wholly within your deployment zone. If your opponent has any units with similar abilities, roll off; starting with the winner of the roll-off, take it in turns to resolve these abilities.

profiles.name: 45: Swift Strike
chars: You can always choose this model to fight first in the Fight phase even if it did not charge. If the enemy has units that have charged, or that have a similar ability, alternate choosing units to fight with, starting with the player whose turn is taking place.

profiles.name: 46: Foresight
chars: Once per battle, if this model is on the battlefield, you can re-roll one hit roll, wound roll, damage roll or saving throw.

profiles.name: 51: Inspirational Leader
chars: Friendly <Sub-faction>units can use this model’s Leadership instead of their own while they are within 6" of it.

profiles.name: 52: Rallying Cry
chars: You can re-roll failed Morale tests for friendly <Sub-faction>units while they are within 6" of this model.

profiles.name: 53: Icon of Retribution
chars: Roll a dice each time a friendly <Sub-faction>model within 6" of this model is slain in the Fight phase. On a 6, the unit that made the attack that slew the model suffers 1 mortal wound after it has finished making its attacks.

profiles.name: 54: Impetuous
chars: You can re-roll failed charge rolls for this model.

profiles.name: 55: Terrifying
chars: Subtract 1 from the Leadership characteristic of enemy units while they are within 3" of this model.

profiles.name: 56: Savage Riposte
chars: Each time you roll an unmodified saving throw of 6 for this model in the Fight phase, the enemy unit that made the attack suffers 1 mortal wound after it has resolved all of its attacks.

profiles.name: 61: Air Strike
chars: Once per battle, in your Shooting phase, you can pick an enemy unit, other than a Characterunit, that is visible to this model and roll a D6. On a 1-4 nothing happens. On a 5+ the target unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

profiles.name: 62: Swift Advance
chars: When this model Advances, add 6" to its Move characteristic for that Movement phase instead of rolling a D6

profiles.name: 63: Reactive Tactics
chars: This model, and friendly<Sub-faction>units within 6" of them, can charge even if they Fell Back that turn.

profiles.name: 64: Strike and Fade
chars: After this model has fought in the Fight phase, it can immediately pile in D3+3" in any direction, not just towards the closest enemy model.

profiles.name: 65: Final Strike
chars: If this model is slain, you can select an enemy unit within 3" of it and roll a D6; on a 2+ that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

profiles.name: 66: Direct Fire
chars: Each time you make a wound roll of 6+ in the Shooting phase for a friendly <Sub-faction>unit within 6" of this model, the AP characteristic of that attack is improved by 1 (e.g. AP -1 becomes AP -2).

profiles.name: 02: Auto-loader
chars: Pick one of this model’s ranged weapons. Increase the number of shots this weapon makes by 1 (e.g. a Pistol 1 weapon becomes a Pistol 2 weapon).

profiles.name: 03: Penetrator Rounds
chars: Pick one of this model’s ranged weapons. Improve that weapon’s AP characteristic by 1 (e.g. AP -1 becomes AP -2).

profiles.name: 04: High Calibre
chars: Pick one of this model’s ranged weapons. Add 1 to that weapon’s Strength characteristic.

profiles.name: 05: Improved Sights
chars: Pick one of this model’s ranged weapons. Add 6" to that weapon’s Range characteristic.

profiles.name: 06: Inferno Round
chars: Pick one of this model’s ranged weapons. Add the following ability to that weapon: ‘Units do not receive the benefit of cover to their saving throws against attacks made with this weapon.’

profiles.name: 07: Artificer Weapon
chars: Pick one of this model’s weapons. Add 1 to that weapon’s Damage characteristic.

profiles.name: 08: Finely Balanced
chars: Pick one of this model’s melee weapons. Add the following ability to that weapon: ‘Each time the bearer fights, it can make 1 additional attack with this weapon.’

profiles.name: 09: Shredder
chars: Pick one of this model’s melee weapons. Add the following ability to that weapon: ‘You can re-roll failed wound rolls for attacks made with this weapon.’

profiles.name: 10: Brutal
chars: Pick one of this model’s melee weapons. Improve that weapon’s Strength characteristic by 1 (e.g. User becomes +1, +1 becomes +2).

profiles.name: 11: Razor-edged
chars: Pick one of this model’s melee weapons. Improve that weapon’s AP characteristic by 1 (e.g. AP -1 becomes AP -2).

profiles.name: 12: Heirloom
chars: Pick one of this model’s melee weapons. Add the following ability to that weapon: ‘Each unmodified hit roll of 6 made for attacks with this weapon scores 2 hits instead of 1’.

profiles.name: 1: Psychic Might
chars: Add 1 to the number of psychic powers this character can attempt to manifest in your Psychic phase.

profiles.name: 2: Adamantium Will
chars: Add 1 to the number of psychic powers this character can attempt to deny in your opponent’s Psychic phase.

profiles.name: 3: Master of Lore
chars: Add 1 to the number of psychic powers this model knows from one of the psychic disciplines available to them.

chars: Add 1 to this model’s Leadership characteristic.

profiles.name: 04: Ferocious Combatant
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Attacks characteristic.

profiles.name: 05: Mighty
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Strength characteristic.

profiles.name: 06: Dead-eyed
chars: Improve this model’s Ballistic Skill characteristic by 1 (e.g. BS 3+ will become BS 2+), to a maximum of 2+.

profiles.name: 07: Fleet
chars: Add 2" to this model’s Move characteristic.

profiles.name: 08: Blademaster
chars: Improve this model’s Weapon Skill characteristic by 1 (e.g. WS 3+ will become WS 2+), to a maximum of 2+.

profiles.name: 09: Enhanced Physiology
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Toughness characteristic.

profiles.name: 10: Toughened Armor
chars: Improve this model’s Save characteristic by 1 (e.g. Sv 5+ will become Sv 4+), to a maximum of 2+.

profiles.name: 11: Divine Protection
chars: Improve this model’s invulnerable save by 1 (e.g. an invulnerable save of 5+ will become an invulnerable save of 4+), to a maximum of 3+. If this model does not have an invulnerable save, it instead gains a 6+ invulnerable save.

profiles.name: 12: Heroic Constitution
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Wounds characteristic.

profiles.name: Aura of Discipline
chars: All friendly DEATH KORPS OF KRIEG units within 6" of a COMMISSAR can use the Commissar's Leadership instead of their own.

profiles.name: Summary Execution
chars: Friendly ASTRA MILITARUM units within 6" of a Death Korps Death Rider Commissar can never lose more than one model as the result of any single failed Morale test.

profiles.name: The Cult of Sacrifice
chars: This unit ignores models slain in the Shooting phase when taking Morale tests.

profiles.name: Death Korps Voice of Command
chars: This unit may issue order to those under their command at the start of any of their Shooting phases. Orders may only be issued to INFANTRY or CAVALRY units within 6" of this unit that have the DEATH KORPS OF KRIEG keyword. To issue an order, pick a target unit and choose which order you wish to issue from the table below. A unit may only be affected by one order per turn.

profiles.name: Plasma pistol, Supercharge
chars: On a hit roll of 1, the bearer is slain.

profiles.name: Chainsword
chars: Each time the bearer fights, it can make 1 additional attack with this weapon.

profiles.name: Power fist
chars: When attacking with this weapon, you must subtract 1 from the hit roll.

profiles.name: Grand Strategist
chars: Whilst your Warlord is alive, you can re-roll a single hit roll, wound roll or saving throw per battle. In addition, if your army is Battle-forged and this Warlord is on the battlefield, roll a dice for each Command Point spent when using Stratagems. On a 5+ that Command Point is immediately refunded

profiles.name: Old Grudges
chars: After deployment, but before the first battle round begins, choose a unit in your opponent’s army. You can re-roll failed wound rolls for ASTRA MILITARUM units from your army that target the unit you chose whilst they are within 6" of your Warlord.

profiles.name: Implacable Determination
chars: When your Warlord and a single friendly unit within 3" of them Advances, they may both add 6" to their Move characteristic for that Movement phase instead of rolling a dice

profiles.name: Draconian Disiplinarian
chars: You can re-roll failed Morale tests for friendly ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY units within 6" of your Warlord in the Morale phase.

profiles.name: Bellowing Voice
chars: Add 3" to the range of any abilities on your Warlord’s datasheet (such as Aura of Discipline or Voice of Command).

profiles.name: Master of Command
chars: Your Warlord gains the Voice of Command ability. If your Warlord already has the Voice of Command or Tank Orders ability, they may instead issue one additional order per turn.

profiles.name: Lord of Ordnance
chars: Each time you roll a wound roll of 6+ for an attack made by a friendly EMPEROR’S WRATH unit while they are within 6" of your Warlord in the Shooting phase, the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack is improved by 1 (i.e. AP0 becomes AP-1, AP-1 becomes AP-2).

profiles.name: Unflinching Resolve
chars: You can re-roll hit rolls when your Warlord, and friendly EMPEROR’S FIST units within 6" of your Warlord, fire Overwatch.

profiles.name: Legendary Fighter
chars: If this warlord charges in the charge phase, add 1 to their attacks characteristic until the end of the ensuing fight phase.

profiles.name: Inspiring Leader
chars: Friendly units within 6" of this warlord can add 1 to their leadership characteristic.

profiles.name: Tenacious Survivor
chars: Roll a dice each time this warlord loses a wound. On a 6, the warlord shrugs off the damage and does not lose the wound.

profiles.name: The Laurels of Command
chars: OFFICER with Voice of Command ability only. Roll a dice each time the bearer issues an order to a friendly <REGIMENT>unit within 6" of them. On a 4+ the bearer can immediately issue another order to the same unit. This does not count towards the maximum number of orders this model may issue each turn.

profiles.name: The Emperor's Benediction
chars: COMMISSAR or LORD COMMISSAR with a bolt pistol only. The Emperor’s Benediction replaces the model’s bolt pistol and has the following profile:

profiles.name: The Emperor's Benediction
chars: This weapon can target a Character even if it is not the closest enemy unit, unless the bearer is within 1" of an enemy unit.

profiles.name: The Deathmask of Ollanius
chars: INFANTRY model only. The bearer of this item has a 4+ invulnerable save. In addition, once per game, at the start of any of your turns, the bearer may immediately heal D3 wounds.

profiles.name: The Dagger of Tu'Sakh
chars: INFANTRY OFFICER model only. During deployment, you can set up the bearer and one INFANTRY unit from your army behind enemy lines instead of placing them on the battlefield. The infantry unit must have the same <REGIMENT> keyword as the bearer if the bearer has one.At the end of any of your Movement phases these units can launch their daring attack – set them up within 3" of each other, anywhere on the battlefield that is wholly within 6" of any battlefield edge and more than 9" away from any enemy models.

profiles.name: Kurov's Aquila
chars: OFFICERS only. Each time your opponent uses a Stratagem, roll a D6. On a 5+ you gain 1 Command Point.

profiles.name: The Blade of Conquest
chars: Model with power sword only. The Blade of Conquest replaces the model’s power sword and has the following profile:

profiles.name: Hammer of Sunderance
chars: Model with battle cannon only. Hammer of Sunderance replaces the bearer’s battle cannon and has the following profile:

profiles.name: Agripinaa-Class Orbital Tracker
chars: In your Shooting phase, pick an EMPEROR’S WRATH unit from your army within 6" of the bearer. Until the end of that phase, enemy units do not receive the benefit of cover when targeted by shooting attacks made by that unit.

profiles.name: Duty unto death!
chars: Any INFANTRY or CALVARY model in the units that is killed in the Fight phase immediately makes a single attack.

profiles.name: Without Mercy
chars: All lasguns and hot-shot lasguns in the ordered unit change their Type to Pistol 2 until the end of the turn.

profiles.name: Forwards for the Emperor!
chars: The ordered unit can shoot this phase even if it Advanced in its Movement phase.

profiles.name: Get Back in the Fight!
chars: The ordered unit can shoot this phase even if it Fell Back in its Movement phase.

profiles.name: Move! Move! Move!
chars: Instead of shooting this phase, the ordered unit immediately moves as if it were the Movement phase. It must Advance as part of this move, and cannot declare a charge during this turn.

profiles.name: Fix Bayonets!
chars: This order can only be issued to units that are within 1" of an enemy unit. The ordered unit immediately fights as if it were the Fight phase.

profiles.name: Bring it Down!
chars: Re-roll wound rolls of 1 for all the models in the ordered unit until the end of the phase.

profiles.name: 04: Ferocious Combatant

profiles.name: 05: Mighty

profiles.name: 06: Dead-eyed
chars: Improve this model’s Ballistic Skill characteristic by 1 (e.g. BS 3+ will become BS 2+), to a maximum of 2+.

profiles.name: 07: Fleet
chars: Add 2" to this model’s Move characteristic.

profiles.name: 08: Blademaster
chars: Improve this model’s Weapon Skill characteristic by 1 (e.g. WS 3+ will become WS 2+), to a maximum of 2+.

profiles.name: 09: Enhanced Physiology
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Toughness characteristic.

profiles.name: 10: Toughened Armor
chars: Improve this model’s Save characteristic by 1 (e.g. Sv 5+ will become Sv 4+), to a maximum of 2+.

profiles.name: 11: Divine Protection

chars: Add 1 to this model’s Wounds characteristic.

profiles.name: The Cult of Sacrifice
chars: This unit ignores models slain in the Shooting phase when taking Morale tests.

profiles.name: Vitae Mortis
chars: Each time a friendly DEATH KORPS OF KRIEG INFANTRY or DEATH KORPS OF KRIEG CAVALRY unit within 6" suffers a wound, roll a D6. On a 6, it ignores the injury and the wound is not lost. A unit cannot use both this and the Augmented Mount ability to prevent the same wound.

profiles.name: Death Korps Voice of Command
chars: This unit may issue order to those under their command at the start of any of their Shooting phases. Orders may only be issued to INFANTRY or CAVALRY units within 6" of this unit that have the DEATH KORPS OF KRIEG keyword. To issue an order, pick a target unit and choose which order you wish to issue from the table below. A unit may only be affected by one order per turn.

profiles.name: Plasma pistol, Supercharge
chars: On a hit roll of 1, the bearer is slain.

profiles.name: Chainsword
chars: Each time the bearer fights, it can make 1 additional attack with this weapon.

profiles.name: Power fist
chars: When attacking with this weapon, you must subtract 1 from the hit roll.

profiles.name: Medi-pack
chars: At the end of any of your Movement phases, a model with a medi-pack can attempt to heal a single model. Select a friendly DEATH KORPS OF KRIEG INFANTRY unit within 3" and roll a D6. On a roll of 4+, one model in the unit recovers a wound it lost earlier in the battle (if the unit has a Wounds characteristic of 1, one model slain earlier in the battle is returned to the unit instead). A unit can only be the target of this ability once in each turn.

profiles.name: The Laurels of Command
chars: OFFICER with Voice of Command ability only. Roll a dice each time the bearer issues an order to a friendly <REGIMENT>unit within 6" of them. On a 4+ the bearer can immediately issue another order to the same unit. This does not count towards the maximum number of orders this model may issue each turn.

profiles.name: The Emperor's Benediction
chars: COMMISSAR or LORD COMMISSAR with a bolt pistol only. The Emperor’s Benediction replaces the model’s bolt pistol and has the following profile:

profiles.name: The Emperor's Benediction
chars: This weapon can target a Character even if it is not the closest enemy unit, unless the bearer is within 1" of an enemy unit.

profiles.name: The Deathmask of Ollanius
chars: INFANTRY model only. The bearer of this item has a 4+ invulnerable save. In addition, once per game, at the start of any of your turns, the bearer may immediately heal D3 wounds.

profiles.name: The Dagger of Tu'Sakh
chars: INFANTRY OFFICER model only. During deployment, you can set up the bearer and one INFANTRY unit from your army behind enemy lines instead of placing them on the battlefield. The infantry unit must have the same <REGIMENT> keyword as the bearer if the bearer has one.At the end of any of your Movement phases these units can launch their daring attack – set them up within 3" of each other, anywhere on the battlefield that is wholly within 6" of any battlefield edge and more than 9" away from any enemy models.

profiles.name: Kurov's Aquila
chars: OFFICERS only. Each time your opponent uses a Stratagem, roll a D6. On a 5+ you gain 1 Command Point.

profiles.name: The Blade of Conquest
chars: Model with power sword only. The Blade of Conquest replaces the model’s power sword and has the following profile:

profiles.name: Hammer of Sunderance

profiles.name: Agripinaa-Class Orbital Tracker
chars: In your Shooting phase, pick an EMPEROR’S WRATH unit from your army within 6" of the bearer. Until the end of that phase, enemy units do not receive the benefit of cover when targeted by shooting attacks made by that unit.

profiles.name: Grand Strategist
chars: Whilst your Warlord is alive, you can re-roll a single hit roll, wound roll or saving throw per battle. In addition, if your army is Battle-forged and this Warlord is on the battlefield, roll a dice for each Command Point spent when using Stratagems. On a 5+ that Command Point is immediately refunded

profiles.name: Old Grudges
chars: After deployment, but before the first battle round begins, choose a unit in your opponent’s army. You can re-roll failed wound rolls for ASTRA MILITARUM units from your army that target the unit you chose whilst they are within 6" of your Warlord.

profiles.name: Implacable Determination
chars: When your Warlord and a single friendly unit within 3" of them Advances, they may both add 6" to their Move characteristic for that Movement phase instead of rolling a dice

profiles.name: Draconian Disiplinarian
chars: You can re-roll failed Morale tests for friendly ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY units within 6" of your Warlord in the Morale phase.

profiles.name: Bellowing Voice
chars: Add 3" to the range of any abilities on your Warlord’s datasheet (such as Aura of Discipline or Voice of Command).

profiles.name: Master of Command
chars: Your Warlord gains the Voice of Command ability. If your Warlord already has the Voice of Command or Tank Orders ability, they may instead issue one additional order per turn.

profiles.name: Lord of Ordnance
chars: Each time you roll a wound roll of 6+ for an attack made by a friendly EMPEROR’S WRATH unit while they are within 6" of your Warlord in the Shooting phase, the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack is improved by 1 (i.e. AP0 becomes AP-1, AP-1 becomes AP-2).

profiles.name: Unflinching Resolve

chars: Each time you roll an unmodified saving throw of 6 for this model in the Fight phase, the enemy unit that made that attack suffers 1 mortal wound after it has resolved all of its attacks.

chars: Roll a D6 each time a model in this unit loses a wound; on a 5+ the model does not lose that wound

chars: You can re-roll charge rolls for this model.

rules.name: Independent Operative
rules.text: This Model can never have a Warlord Trait. During deployment, you can set this model up in concealment instead of placing it on the battlefield. At the end of any of your movement phases, this model can reveal it's position - set it up anywhere on the battlefield that is more then 9" from any enemy model.

rules.name: Lightning Reflexes
rules.text: A model with this special rule has a 4+ invulnerable save.

rules.name: Execution Force
rules.text: So long as your Warlord is from the IMPERIUM, you can include this unit in a Vanguard Detachment even if that Detachment contains no HQ units. However, if you do so, that Detachment's Command Benefits are changed to 'None' unless that Detachment contains exactly 1 of each assassin.

profiles.name: Spy Mask
chars: Enemy models do not gain the bonus to thier saving throws for being in cover against attacks made with ranged weapons by this model.

profiles.name: Stealth Suit

profiles.name: Deadshot
chars: This model can target a CHARACTER even if it is not the closest enemy unit. In addition, each time an unmodified wound roll of 6 is made for an attack with a ranged weapon by this model, the Damage for that attack is D6

profiles.name: Faultless Aim
chars: If this model remained stationary in its previous movement phase, it always hits on a 2+ when firing a ranged weapon, regardless of modifiers. (hit rolls of 6 are still required when firing overwatch)

profiles.name: Head Shot
chars: After this model has made an attack with a ranged weapon, roll one D6 if a model suffered damage from that attack but has not been slain; on a 3+ that model suffers 1 mortal wound and, if that model is not slain, you can roll one more D6. This time, that model suffers 1 mortal wound on a 4+. Keep rolling one D6, increasing the result required, to cause a mortal wound by 1 each time, until the model being rolled for is slain or the roll is failed.

rules.name: Independent Operative
rules.text: This Model can never have a Warlord Trait. During deployment, you can set this model up in concealment instead of placing it on the battlefield. At the end of any of your movement phases, this model can reveal it's position - set it up anywhere on the battlefield that is more then 9" from any enemy model.

rules.name: Lightning Reflexes
rules.text: A model with this special rule has a 4+ invulnerable save.

rules.name: Execution Force
rules.text: So long as your Warlord is from the IMPERIUM, you can include this unit in a Vanguard Detachment even if that Detachment contains no HQ units. However, if you do so, that Detachment's Command Benefits are changed to 'None' unless that Detachment contains exactly 1 of each assassin.

profiles.name: Blind Grenades
chars: This weapon does not inflict any damage on the target. Instead, if a unit is hit by any blind grenades, your opponent must subtract 1 from all hit rolls made until the end of the turn.

profiles.name: Exitus Rifle
chars: Invulnerable saves cannot be taken against a wound inflicted by this weapon. This weapon inflicts wounds against INFANTRY units on 2+

chars: Invulnerable saves cannot be taken against a wound inflicted by this weapon. This weapon inflicts wounds against INFANTRY units on 2+

profiles.name: 16: Deadly Charge

profiles.name: 26: Defensive Fighter

profiles.name: 31: Grudge

profiles.name: 32: Resilient

profiles.name: 35: Indomitable

profiles.name: 36: Impervious

profiles.name: 43: Hard to Kill

profiles.name: 44: Strategic Feint
chars: At the start of the first battle round but before the first turn begins, you can pick a friendly <Sub-faction> unit within 6" of this model and set it up again, anywhere wholly within your deployment zone. If your opponent has any units with similar abilities, roll off; starting with the winner of the roll-off, take it in turns to resolve these abilities.

profiles.name: 45: Swift Strike
chars: You can always choose this model to fight first in the Fight phase even if it did not charge. If the enemy has units that have charged, or that have a similar ability, alternate choosing units to fight with, starting with the player whose turn is taking place.

profiles.name: 46: Foresight
chars: Once per battle, if this model is on the battlefield, you can re-roll one hit roll, wound roll, damage roll or saving throw.

profiles.name: 51: Inspirational Leader
chars: Friendly <Sub-faction>units can use this model’s Leadership instead of their own while they are within 6" of it.

profiles.name: 52: Rallying Cry

profiles.name: 53: Icon of Retribution

profiles.name: 54: Impetuous

profiles.name: 55: Terrifying

profiles.name: 56: Savage Riposte

units.name: Death Korps Leman Russ Mars-Alpha Battle Tanks

profiles.name: Grinding Advance
chars: If this model remains stationary or moves under half speed in its Movement phase (i.e. it moves a distance in inches less than half of its current Move characteristic) it can shoot its turret weapon twice in the following Shooting phase (the turret weapon must target the same unit both times). Furthermore, hit rolls for this model’s turret weapon do not suffer the penalty for moving and shooting a Heavy weapon. The following weapons are turret weapons: battle cannon, Conqueror battle cannon, Demolisher cannon, Eradicator nova cannon, Executioner plasma cannon, Exterminator autocannon, Punisher gatling cannon, Stygies Vanquisher battle cannon, twin lascannon and Vanquisher battle cannon.

profiles.name: Emergency Plasma Vents
chars: If this model fires a supercharged plasma cannon, and you roll one or more hit rolls of 1, it is not automatically destroyed. Instead, for each hit roll of 1, the bearer suffers 1 mortal wound after all of this weapon's shots have been resolved.

profiles.name: Grinding Advance

It can, except when firing Overwatch, also still fire its weapons if enemy units are within 1" of it (but only its twin heavy bolter or twin heavy flamer can target units that are within 1" of it – its other guns must target other units). In addition, this model only gains a bonus to its save in cover if at least half the model is obscured from the firer.

profiles.name: Smoke Launchers
chars: Once per game, instead of shooting any weapons in the Shooting phase, this model can use its Smoke Launchers; until your next Shooting phase your opponent must subtract 1 from all hit rolls for ranged weapons that target this vehicle.

profiles.name: Explodes (6+/2D6"/D6)
chars: If this model is reduced to 0 wounds, roll a D6 before removing it from the battlefield. On a 6 it explodes, and each unit within 2D6" suffers D6 mortal wounds.

profiles.name: Macharius Vanquisher Cannon Armour Piercing Shells
chars: Roll 2 dice when inflicting damage with this weapon and discard the lowest result.

profiles.name: Heavy flamer
chars: This weapon automatically hits its target

profiles.name: Hunter-killer missile
chars: A model can only fire each of its hunter killer missiles once per battle.

profiles.name: R1: Sharpshooters
chars: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for this unit in the Shooting phase.

profiles.name: R1: Agile
chars: You can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls for this unit.

profiles.name: R1: Deadeye Shots
chars: Each time you roll an unmodified wound roll of 6 for an attack with one of this unit’s ranged weapons, increase the Damage characteristic of that attack by 1.

profiles.name: R1: Grizzled
chars: This unit ignores penalties to their Leadership characteristic.

profiles.name: R2: Combat Specialists
chars: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for this unit in the Fight phase.

profiles.name: R2: Assassins
chars: Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by models in this unit that target an enemy CHARACTER unit.

profiles.name: R3: Trophy Takers
chars: Subtract 1 from the Leadership characteristic of enemy units while they are within 6" of this unit.

profiles.name: R4: Disciplined
chars: This unit can shoot or charge during a turn in which it Fell Back.

profiles.name: R5: Brutal
chars: Add 1 to the Strength and Attacks characteristic of models in this unit during any turn in which they made a successful charge move.

profiles.name: R2: Lucky
chars: Roll a D6 each time a model from this unit loses a wound; on a 6 the model does not lose that wound.

profiles.name: R3: Breachers
chars: Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by models in this unit if the target of those attacks is receiving the benefit of cover.

profiles.name: R1: Unstoppable Beast
chars: After this model completes a charge move, roll a D6 for each enemy unit within 1" of it. On a 4+ that unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

profiles.name: R1: Monstrous Regeneration
chars: This model regains 1 lost wound at the start of each of your turns.

profiles.name: R2: Terrifying
chars: Subtract 1 from the Leadership characteristic of enemy units while they are within 6" of this model.

profiles.name: R2: Lashing Limbs
chars: Each time you roll an unmodified saving throw of 6 for this model in the Fight phase, the enemy unit that made that attack suffers 1 mortal wound after it has resolved all of its attacks.

profiles.name: R3: Inhuman Resilience
chars: Roll a D6 each time a model in this unit loses a wound; on a 5+ the model does not lose that wound

profiles.name: R3: Sweeping Blows
chars: Each unmodified hit roll of 6 made for this model’s attacks in the Fight phase score 2 hits instead of 1.

profiles.name: R4: Juggernaut
chars: You can re-roll charge rolls for this model.

profiles.name: R5: Just Making it Angry
chars: If this model has a damage table, double the number of wounds it has remaining for the purposes of determining what its Strength and Attacks characteristics are.

profiles.name: R5: Eager
chars: At the start of the first battle round but before the first turn begins, you can move this model up to 5". It cannot end this move within 9" of any enemy models. If both players have units that can do this, the player who is taking the first turn moves their units first.
